items.issue: SCR555 unresolved slot names asked for F1/B1 tuple order, while accepted SCR554 canonicalizes F1/B1 as named canonical-JSON objects rather than positional tuples.
items.resolution: M2 copies the accepted SCR554 F1_id/B1_id canonical-object formulas verbatim and does not invent an upstream tuple. The only positional tuple remains the V555 seven-field route identity.

items.issue: S554D warned that rule version/hash differences must not turn one semantic support under unresolved authority into multiple positive supports; SCR554 also makes version/hash identity-sensitive after resolution.
items.resolution: SCR554 order 3 STATIC_AUTHORITY_COMPLETENESS runs before duplicate equivalence and F1 emission. For one exact invocation, unknown/conflicting required authority without governed precedence is K07/no-F1. Therefore a mixed/unresolved snapshot cannot exploit later rule-version/hash identity sensitivity to appear as a second positive F1. H14/H29 identity sensitivity applies only after the authority relation itself is exact/resolved.

items.issue: SCR554 M2 handoff requires exact F1_id/B1_id, while SCR555 freezes a seven-field route tuple beginning only with EXACT_V554_F1_REF.
items.resolution: B1 is accepted SCR554 permission/reference/replay boundary proof. It must bind the exact F1 and allowed_v555_structural_use=true but is not an eighth route semantic participant and contributes zero route multiplicity.

items.issue: B1 may contain sorted F2_ids while V555 has an independently governed route-born predicate family.
items.resolution: Canonical SCR554 F2 remains V554-owned and reference-only. V555 does not copy, rename, re-evaluate, or use F2 to fill the valid-empty route-born predicate registry.

items.issue: M1 is not a launch dependency, but may later require a material SCR554 contract change.
items.resolution: This M2 return is accepted only against SCR554 head b5d745ac70c833324c8be0addf6c08ad72372263 and EXACT_CONTRACT.json blob 4bce143b087d5e38dbb4829a979a3f43abf9ab90. A material M1-driven SCR554 change makes this return stale and requires recheck.
